items.key: (controller = '{[$controller]}' or (controller is null and (1 = 1 or charindex(',' + ma_truong + ',', (select ',' + replace(rtrim(hide), ' ', '') + ',' from voucherinfo where ma_ct = '{[$ma_ct]}')) = 0))) and status = 1

query.text: declare @controller varchar(128) select top 1 @controller = rtrim(controller) from dmtktct where ma_ct = (select ma_ct from dmbbnct where stt_rec = @stt_rec) select @@fieldExternal from @@table a left join dmdvcs b on a.ma_dvcs = b.ma_dvcs left join @@sysDatabaseName..vdmtbbn c on a.ma_truong = c.id and (controller = @controller or controller is null) where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause
